blocks.question: May 2024 TZ1 Paper 2, Question 9
blocks.task_summary: Find the total number of seating arrangements with Alvin and Bobby sitting next to each other in the same row.
method_path: Determine number of ways to seat Alvin and Bobby as a block, considering row adjacency
Arrange the other 8 children in 8! ways
accepted_alternatives: Alternative method: 2 × 9! − 2 × 8! (treat as a line of 10, subtract cases where block straddles rows 5 and 6)

evidence.basis: METHOD 1: number of ways Alvin and Bobby can be seated is 2×8=16; number of ways other children 8!; total 16×8! = 645120

blocks.question: May 2024 TZ1 Paper 2, Question 9
blocks.task_summary: Find the total number of seating arrangements with Alvin and Bobby adjacent, and Catalina and Daniela not adjacent.
method_path: Find arrangements where A,B adjacent AND C,D adjacent via casework (end vs non-end)
Case 1: A,B at end (8 ways), C,D together 12 ways, others 6! → 8640
Case 2: A,B not at end (8 ways), C,D together 10 ways, others 6! → 7200
accepted_alternatives: Alternative method: Direct casework based on A,B position (end/non-end) and counting C,D non-adjacent placements, adding possibilities (Case 1: 8×31680, Case 2: 8×33120, total 518400)

evidence.basis: METHOD 1: attempt to find number A,B adjacent AND C,D adjacent and subtract from part (a); Case 1: A,B end (8 ways), C,D together 12 ways, arrangements 12×6!=8640; Case 2: A,B not end (8 ways), C,D together 10 ways, 10×6!=7200; total = 645120 – (69120+57600) = 518400
